title: research-team evidence log
description: The evidence ledger, checked by scripts/evidence_auditor.py. The schema field has the form 'research-evidence-1.3': a mismatched major version stops the pipeline, a differing minor version is accepted as forward compatible (ledgers from 1.0-1.2 still load). Optional fields: source.doi / source.arxiv_id / archive / superseded_by / self_reported / lineage, search_log.role, search_log.facet, top-level floor_status, key_questions.relevance, floor_status.early_stop. key_questions has minItems 1 so that a single-KQ ledger promoted from LIGHT is accepted; the planning rule of 2-7 key questions is checked by research_plan_linter.py.

deliverable_language.description: The language the prose of the deliverables is written in — the language of the request, as a BCP 47 tag such as en or ja. Their structure (section headings, table headers, confidence labels) is English whatever this says. Absent means en

relevance.description: Decision relevance. decision marks a KQ that directly drives the conclusion or recommendation (at most four in DEEP); background marks a premise or context KQ and gets the STANDARD floors. A KQ with no value is treated as decision (collection_standards.md §1)

claim.description: One falsifiable proposition, third person. No causation, implication, or recommendation

verbatim_quote.description: A verbatim quote from the source, in its original language

url.description: A full absolute URL, nothing abbreviated

origin_cluster.description: Independence cluster ID. The same value for the same publisher or a reprint relationship

descriptor.description: A narrative descriptor for a source that drives the conclusion (access to the data, motive, likely bias, freshness)

doi.description: Optional. The DOI of an academic source (for example 10.18653/v1/2023.emnlp-main.398); citation_verifier.py checks that it resolves

arxiv_id.description: Optional. The arXiv ID (for example 2402.14207); citation_verifier.py checks that it resolves

staleness_note.description: The reason for using data older than the three-year freshness rule

archive.description: Optional. A Wayback snapshot for a source URL that cannot be reached; the parent or the verifier writes back what citation_verifier.py found

superseded_by.description: Optional. The ID of the evidence that replaced this one when conflicting newer evidence was confirmed. The original is never deleted, only marked; the report must not rest on it (report_auditor.py checks this)

self_reported.description: Optional (default false). A figure published by the method's proposer, a vendor, or an interested party. Where it is also a key figure, the report must say so explicitly

lineage.description: Optional. Which agent run produced this evidence, and from which key question

fragment_file.description: Path of the evidence fragment JSON (for example evidence_fragments/kq1_collector.json)

confidence_band.description: One label from the seven-level confidence vocabulary (interpretation_contract.md §5)

alternatives.description: Alternative hypotheses and the indicators that would change their likelihood (collection_standards.md §8-4). Collection agents write them into the fragment and merge_fragments.py passes them through; the element shape is not constrained

disconfirmation.description: The record of the disconfirmation search. In STANDARD and DEEP, evidence_auditor.py fails an empty one; the schema itself does not require it, so that a ledger promoted from LIGHT is accepted

expected_if_false.description: What would be observed if the hypothesis were false (listed before searching)

found.description: The disconfirming fact found. Where none was, say so explicitly

kq_id.description: The key question this disconfirmation search belongs to; merge_fragments.py attaches it

facet.description: Which of the four search facets in collection_standards.md §2 this query covers. Optional; validate_fragment.py warns when a facet is missing from a fragment

role.description: The collection role that ran this search; merge_fragments.py derives it from the fragment file name. Needed for the per-role floor checks in DEEP

floor_status.description: Floor status per fragment, taken from the collection agents' reports by merge_fragments.py. evidence_auditor.py uses it for the per-role floor judgement in DEEP and for the early-stop reading

reason.description: The reason a floor was not met

early_stop.description: The record of a conclusion-sufficiency early stop (collection_standards.md §1). Where the three conditions hold and the STANDARD floors are met, a shortfall is reported as WARN rather than FAIL
